snippet.title: Under Investigation - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Investigate strange phenomena, use your camera to determine whether they are real anomalies or unstable phenomena, and keep the station from falling into darkness. Every use of your camera drains its energy faster, bringing you closer to danger.

Can you identify every anomaly before it's too late?

Under Investigation is a first-person horror game about investigating strange phenomena and identifying anomalies.

Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5327970/Under_Investigation/
